A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DNR research and contain complete main text and Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only pages 1 and 7 differ.

before.justification: v3 reports original offline recommendation experiments in Section 4 and Appendix E, including ablations, computational measurements and an industrial online A/B test.

after.justification: v4 retains the original offline experiments, supplementary analyses and industrial online A/B results, including Tables 1–3 and 8–15.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same noise generators, denoising and adversarial objectives, distribution regularization, and training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same ML-1M, Kuaivideo and Amazon data experiments and industrial video-feed evaluation. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Table 1, including PRM, Pier, MG-E and DCDR, and in the ablation and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Data splits, top-50 candidate and top-6 output settings, metrics, model configurations, hyperparameters and online traffic allocation remain unchanged. Removing the GPU disclosure does not establish a changed experimental procedure.

E4.justification: The score-integration and loss ablations, noise-distribution analyses, hyperparameter sensitivity, larger-backbone and alternative-retriever experiments, diversity analysis and computational comparisons are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the Student t-test threshold of p < 0.05. Appendix E.6 and Table 11 retain identical uncertainty and significance reporting, with no added run or seed information.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains DNR-B's Kuaivideo NDCG@6 of 70.15, and Table 11 retains the +1.089% realshow result.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, assumptions and Equations (1)–(10) are unchanged, including the objective derivations and direct-optimization analysis in Appendix B.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about informative retriever scores, reranking as denoising, the adversarial framework and its effectiveness.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, online metric tradeoffs, generalizability interpretations and Appendix F's computational limitations and future directions are identical.

D1.justification: v4 removes 'on Nvidia A40 GPUs' from Section 4.1 without providing replacement hardware information elsewhere. Software versions, hyperparameters, training-time measurements and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain identical, including Section 2's related work and Appendix F.2's discussion of end-to-end recommendation.

P1.justification: v4 adds author email contacts to the first-page footnotes, changes author-line punctuation and updates the version/date stamp. Section 4.1's implementation sentence is shortened; section order and scientific narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–15 and Algorithm 1 retain their displays, captions and placement. Page organization is unchanged; the edited prose only undergoes local line rewrapping.

improvement.justification: Removing the only GPU model disclosure in Section 4.1 reduces reproducibility information and the context for Table 15's unchanged training-time measurements. Added author email contacts improve contactability, but the limited loss of technical specificity is the more consequential change; the scientific content otherwise remains identical.
